# superset_dataset_refresh (Resource)

Syncs the columns of a dataset from its source, as the *Sync columns from source* button of the dataset editor does: Superset adds the columns the source gained, removes the ones it lost, updates the type of the ones it has, and recreates the `count` metric when it is missing. Calculated columns and the labels of the columns are kept, while `groupby` and `filterable` are reset to `true`. The sync runs when the resource is created and again whenever `dataset_id` or `triggers` change; it is not undone when the resource is destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sync the columns of a dataset from its source table. Bump the version whenever the table
# gains or loses columns, so Superset picks the change up on the next apply.
resource "superset_dataset_refresh" "sales" {
  dataset_id = superset_dataset.sales.id
  triggers = {
    version = "2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dataset to sync.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change runs the sync again, for example the version of the source table.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dataset.
